t2.title: Technology making us too dependent and lazy
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Is technology making us too dependent and lazy?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Technology has revolutionized our lives. However, I believe it is creating unhealthy dependency and reducing physical activity.

Firstly, we rely on devices for basic tasks. GPS navigation means people no longer remember routes. Calculators replace mental arithmetic. When technology fails, many people feel completely helpless.

Secondly, automation reduces physical effort. Food delivery, robot vacuums, and smart devices mean less movement. Sedentary lifestyles contribute to obesity and health problems worldwide.

However, technology also enables productivity. We accomplish more in less time, freeing hours for meaningful activities. Moreover, technology assists people with disabilities, improving their independence.

Nevertheless, balance is essential. Using technology as a tool rather than a crutch maintains our capabilities. Digital detoxes and conscious usage help prevent over-reliance.

Furthermore, parents should teach children traditional skills alongside technology to ensure future generations remain capable.

In conclusion, technology isn't inherently harmful, but mindful usage is crucial to prevent dependency and maintain an active, capable lifestyle.

t2.sampleB1:
Dear SmartNest Team,

Thank you for your email. I am happy with my new smart home system. The products are good, and the installation was quite easy. The mobile app is also easy to use, which is important.

I think you could develop more devices for the garden. For example, a smart sprinkler system would be very useful. Also, maybe a device that automatically weeds the garden. That would be great! I think a lot of people would buy that.

Overall, I am satisfied with my purchase. Thank you.

Sincerely,
Ulugbek Umarov
t2.sampleB2: Great topic — this is something I've been mulling over for a while, so I'll happily jump in. In my view, there's no denying that technology has made us more dependent. Most of us can't get from A to B without GPS, calculators have all but taken over from doing sums in our heads, and how many people still remember phone numbers off by heart? When the Wi-Fi goes down, everyone seems completely lost. On top of that, food delivery apps and robot vacuums mean we barely have to lift a finger anymore, which arguably feeds into a more sedentary lifestyle. That said, I don't think it's all doom and gloom. Technology also frees up our time and lets us get far more done in a day. For people with disabilities, it can be genuinely life-changing. At the end of the day, I reckon it comes down to how we use it. Treated as a handy tool rather than a crutch, technology makes life easier without switching our brains off. What does everyone else think? Has technology made you lazier, or just more efficient? I'd love to hear your take!
t2.uzSample:
Texnologiya hayotimizni tubdan o'zgartirdi. Biroq, menimcha, u nosog'lom qaramlikni yaratmoqda va jismoniy faollikni kamaytirmoqda.

Birinchidan, biz asosiy vazifalar uchun qurilmalarga tayanib qoldik. GPS navigatsiya odamlarning yo'nalishlarni eslab qolmasligini anglatadi. Kalkulyatorlar og'zaki hisob-kitobni almashtiradi. Texnologiya ishlamay qolganda, ko'pchilik o'zini butunlay ojiz his qiladi.

Ikkinchidan, avtomatlashtirish jismoniy harakatni kamaytiradi. Oziq-ovqat yetkazib berish, robot changyutgichlar va aqlli qurilmalar harakatni kamaytiradi. Harakatsiz turmush tarzi semizlik va butun dunyo bo'ylab sog'liq muammolariga olib keladi.

Biroq, texnologiya unumdorlikni ham oshiradi. Biz kamroq vaqt ichida ko'proq narsaga erishamiz, bu esa mazmunli mashg'ulotlar uchun soatlarni bo'shatadi. Bundan tashqari, texnologiya nogironligi bo'lgan odamlarga yordam beradi va ularning mustaqilligini oshiradi.

Shunga qaramay, muvozanat muhim. Texnologiyadan tayanch o'rniga vosita sifatida foydalanish qobiliyatimizni saqlab qoladi. Raqamli detoks va ongli foydalanish haddan tashqari ishonchni oldini olishga yordam beradi.

Bundan tashqari, ota-onalar kelajak avlodlar qobiliyatli bo'lib qolishini ta'minlash uchun bolalarga texnologiya bilan bir qatorda an'anaviy ko'nikmalarni o'rgatishlari kerak.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, texnologiya o'z-o'zidan zararli emas, lekin qaramlikning oldini olish va faol, qobiliyatli turmush tarzini saqlab qolish uchun ongli foydalanish juda muhimdir.

t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli SmartNest jamoasi,

Elektron pochtangiz uchun rahmat. Men yangi aqlli uy tizimimdan mamnunman. Mahsulotlar yaxshi va o'rnatish juda oson bo'ldi. Mobil ilova ham ishlatish uchun qulay, bu muhim.

Menimcha, siz bog' uchun ko'proq qurilmalar ishlab chiqishingiz mumkin. Masalan, aqlli purkagich tizimi juda foydali bo'lar edi. Shuningdek, bog'ni avtomatik ravishda begona o'tlardan tozalaydigan qurilma ham bo'lishi mumkin. Bu juda zo'r bo'lardi! O'ylaymanki, ko'p odamlar buni sotib olishadi.

Umuman olganda, men xaridimdan qoniqdim. Rahmat.

Hurmat bilan,
Ulugbek Umarov
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli SmartNest jamoasi,

Yaqinda SmartNest xaridim bo'yicha kuzatuv xatingiz uchun rahmat. Umuman olganda, men tizimdan juda mamnunman. O'rnatish jarayoni nisbatan muammosiz kechdi va mobil ilova intuitiv va foydalanuvchilar uchun qulay. Biroq, menimcha, yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar mavjud.

Xususan, men mavjud aqlli uy ekotizimlari bilan ko'proq integratsiyani ko'rishni xohlardim. Hozirda SmartNest tizimi biroz ajratilgan ko'rinadi. Bundan tashqari, mos keluvchi qurilmalar assortimenti biroz cheklangan. Men moslikni kengaytirish uchun boshqa ishlab chiqaruvchilar bilan hamkorlikni kengaytirishni taklif qilaman.

Yangi funksiyalar nuqtai nazaridan, menimcha, yanada murakkab energiya boshqaruv tizimi juda qimmatli bo'ladi. Foydalanish odatlari va real vaqtda narxlash asosida energiya sarfini avtomatik ravishda optimallashtirish qobiliyati muhim sotuv nuqtasi bo'ladi. Shuningdek, eshik qulflari uchun yuzni aniqlash kabi takomillashtirilgan xavfsizlik funksiyalari ham mamnuniyat bilan qabul qilinadi.

Fikrlarimni ko'rib chiqqaningiz uchun tashakkur. SmartNestdan kelgusi yangiliklarni ko'rishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Ulugbek Umarov

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is interested in making their home smarter. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! I know you're curious about smart home technology. I recently installed SmartNest and it's been amazing! I can control lights, heating, and security from my phone. It's so convenient and saves energy too! You should definitely consider it! Take care!
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Laylo,
I have smart home. It is good. Lights on, lights off. Easy. You buy?
Bye!
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Laylo,
I have a smart home now. It is good and easy. The app is good too. I like it because I can turn on the lights with my phone. You should get one, but it is a little expensive.
See you later!
t11.sampleB1:
Dear Laylo,
I wanted to tell you about my new smart home system. I recently installed it, and I think it's great! It's really convenient because I can control everything from my phone, like the lights and the heating. The installation was easy, and the app is simple to use. In my opinion, you should definitely consider getting a smart home system too. It makes life easier!
Best wishes,
Ulugbek Umarov

If you're keen to make your place smarter, just go for it — you won't regret it! Speak soon, Dilnoza Karimova

O'rnatish hayratlanarli darajada sodda edi va mobil ilova intuitiv, bu aniq ortiqcha. Agar siz uyingizni avtomatlashtirishni jiddiy o'ylayotgan bo'lsangiz, men buni o'rganishga arziydi der edim. Bu sarmoya, lekin qo'shimcha qulaylik va potentsial energiya tejash, mening fikrimcha, bunga arziydi.
Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Ulugbek Umarov

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the smart home company. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear SmartNest Team, Thank you for asking about my experience with your smart home system. I am extremely satisfied with the products. The voice control feature works flawlessly, and the app is remarkably intuitive. The energy savings since installation have been noticeable on my bills. However, I have some suggestions. The initial setup required some technical knowledge that slightly frustrated me. Additionally, the customer support wait times were rather long. I would appreciate smart garden devices for outdoor automation. A starter package for beginners would help new users. Also, better integration with other brands' devices would increase flexibility. Overall, SmartNest has modernized my home wonderfully. Yours sincerely, Ulugbek Umarov
t12.sampleA1:
Hi SmartNest,


I like it. App good. Easy. I want more lights. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Dear SmartNest,


Thank you for the letter. I like the smart home. It is good and easy. The app is good too. But the lights are not very bright. I want more lights and a new camera. Thank you.


Bye,
Ulugbek Umarov
t12.sampleB1:
Dear SmartNest Team,


Thank you for your email. I like the smart home system. It is very useful and the app is easy to use, which is good. The installation was okay, but a bit difficult. I think the instructions could be better.


I would like some new features. For example, I want a better security system with more cameras. Also, I think you should make a bigger range of products for the garden.


Overall, I am happy with my purchase.


Sincerely,
Ulugbek Umarov
t12.sampleB2: Dear SmartNest Team, Thank you for getting in touch to ask about my experience with your smart home system. On the whole, I have been very impressed. The installation was carried out smoothly, and the mobile app is refreshingly straightforward to navigate. I have particularly appreciated the voice control, which works without a hitch, and I have already noticed a welcome drop in my energy bills. That said, there is clearly room for improvement. The initial setup instructions were a little confusing, and I was kept waiting far too long when I contacted customer support. Looking ahead, I would strongly encourage you to develop smart garden devices and to improve compatibility with other brands. A beginner-friendly starter package would also go down well with new customers. Thank you for taking my feedback on board. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev
